name: HMDB51: Human Motion Database
description: A foundational action recognition database curated by the Serre Lab at Brown University. Extracted primarily from commercial movies and web video repositories (YouTube, Prelinger Archive). Contains 6,766 video clips across 51 distinct action categories spanning general facial actions, body movements with object interactions, and human body movements. Each clip is annotated with camera viewpoint, motion quality, and lighting conditions.
